# Winter Clothing Canada — full product list

Winter Clothing Canada is an independent guide to winter clothing for real Canadian cold, focused on Mountain Warehouse and Columbia. Retailer links go to the retailers' own pages. Updated November 5, 2026.

Price tracker: all 50 prices below were checked live on the retailer's own site on November 5, 2026, and are re-checked three times a day. 28 of 50 are on sale. Biggest saving: Mountain Warehouse Antarctic Extreme, 63% off ($199.99 CAD, was $539.99 CAD, $340 CAD off). Each product on the page shows the date its price was last checked and the lowest price we have seen. Prices change — the retailer's page is the final word.
